taskforge.name: TaskForge
taskforge.summary: A server-rendered team task manager built with Django and HTMX. It connects project membership, a Kanban board, and day-to-day task workflows.
features: Task assignment, drag-and-drop ordering, comments, due dates, filters, and CSV export.
Membership and owner permissions that restrict access to each project.
Activity logging, a workspace dashboard, and task notifications.
engineering: Database transactions and row locking coordinate concurrent board updates.
Business logic lives in services, with shared permission helpers across views.
Automated tests cover behavior, permissions, and query counts. GitHub Actions runs linting and PostgreSQL tests.

ledgerapi.name: LedgerAPI
ledgerapi.summary: An expense-tracking REST API built with Django REST Framework. Users can manage their categories, expenses, monthly budgets, and spending reports.
features: JWT authentication and user-scoped queries isolate each user’s records.
Filtering, ordering, and pagination make expense data easier to explore.
Spending summaries group totals by category and month, with budgets tracked by currency.
engineering: Decimal arithmetic and database constraints help preserve monetary data integrity.
SQL subqueries calculate budget spending without an extra query for every budget.
OpenAPI documentation, consistent error responses, and CI checks support a predictable API. The test configuration enforces a 90% coverage minimum.
